title: Minimal Ingredient Coverage
description: Given two strings source and target, return the minimum window substring of source such that every character in target (including duplicates) is included in the window. If there is no such substring, return the empty string "".
constraints: source and target consist of uppercase and lowercase English letters.
output_format: A string representing the minimum window substring.

examples.explanation: The minimum window substring "BANC" includes 'A', 'B', and 'C' from target.
The entire string source is the minimum window.
Both 'a's from target must be included, but source only has one 'a', so return "".
